'''Porton Kolp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked for [[IsoTech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was stationned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].
